stages.journal: Kessh the Debt-Bound says a Blackwood factor in Xul-Ha holds a writ against him. He wants it burned. He did not say why the writ is written on skin.
The factor, Veeza-Ei, tells a different story: Kessh sold two families into Blackwood service and the writ is the only record of it.
I must decide what to do with the writ.

outcomes.text: Steal the writ and burn it. Kessh pays. The two families stay lost.
Persuade Veeza-Ei to copy the writ and return the original. Both sides half-satisfied.
Kill Kessh in the Sunken Hall and take the writ from his corpse.
